decision.reasoning_trace: In this shopping session, I was looking for a mid-sized, high-performance Bluetooth speaker with at least 20W of power and a battery life exceeding 15 hours for a long weekend trip. The EWA A106 Pro (prod_bluetooth_speakers_192) is incredibly popular and affordable, but its small size limits the sound stage I need. The Bose SoundLink Color (prod_bluetooth_speakers_071) is a reliable brand, but $99.99 feels steep for its age and sound profile. The HyperGear Beast XL (prod_bluetooth_speakers_072) provides the 30W power I wanted, but several reviews suggested it is quite bulky for travel. Since none of the current options perfectly balance portability, high-wattage output, and modern features within my budget, I have decided not to make a purchase today.
